Diego Ramirez: Quick one from BA trip — I left a cash tip for baggage handling at Hotel Palacio Duhau (handed envelope to bellhop). They gave me a scribbled slip with amount ARS 3,200 and date. No fiscal receipt. Can I expense this?
Sam P.: We can, but need manager approval + backup. Please upload photo of the slip and the hotel folio showing the stay.
Diego Ramirez: Uploaded: https://img.redwood-internal/receipts/dhuau_slip.jpg and https://img.redwood-internal/receipts/dhuau_folio.jpg.
Nina L. (Manager): I approve up to USD 25 for baggage tip. Adding approval here. :white_check_mark:
Finance-Bot: Policy FIN-EXP-TRV-002 applies. Cash tips under USD 50 are allowed with manager approval and a supporting note/photo. Reimbursements default to employee home currency (USD). Convert using mid-market rate on purchase date; acceptable sources: XE/OANDA/Google. Include screenshot of FX source.
Diego Ramirez: I'll convert using OANDA rate for 2026-04-02 and attach screenshot. Any special code to select in the form?
Sam P.: Select expense type "Travel - Tip (Baggage)" and policy code FIN-EXP-TRV-002. Put "Nina L. approved" in the approval comment. Attach both images + FX screenshot.
Diego Ramirez: Submitted expense ID 1001123, amount ARS 3,200 converted to USD using OANDA.
AP-Bot: Expense 1001123 queued for payment. Scheduled for next expense run (Tuesday). If urgency needed, request an advance and tag @sam.
Diego Ramirez: All set, thanks. Closing thread. :smile:
